ic_device.name: LM393B / LM2903B / LM193 / LM293 / LM393 / LM2903 Dual Comparators
ic_device.description: Two independent voltage comparators with open-collector outputs, common-mode input range including ground, designed to operate from a single power supply over a wide voltage range.

port_dependencies.condition: Open-collector output requires pullup; supply powers comparator 1
Open-collector output requires pullup; supply powers comparator 2
Ground return for output sink current
Ground return for output sink current
Output low when positive input higher than negative input
Output sinks when negative input higher than positive input
Output low when positive input higher than negative input
Output sinks when negative input higher than positive input

functional_blocks.name: Comparator 1
functional_blocks.description: PNP Darlington pair input comparator with open-collector NPN output; output sinks when negative input exceeds positive input.

functional_blocks.name: Comparator 2
functional_blocks.description: PNP Darlington pair input comparator with open-collector NPN output; output sinks when negative input exceeds positive input.
